title: ast.dry_run response
description: Per-file unified diff bundle plus an op-level outcome list and a roll-up summary. The diff format is standard unified diff (compatible with `git apply --check`). The transient staged-fs session is discarded before this response is returned, so no on-disk state is touched.

result.description: `ok` when every op applied; `partial` when at least one applied and at least one was rejected; `no_ops_applied` when zero ops applied (empty plan or all rejected).

per_file_unified_diff.description: One entry per file touched by the plan, in path-sorted order.

diff.description: Unified-diff body including `---`/`+++` headers, hunk markers, and `\ No newline at end of file` annotations where applicable. Empty when before == after for this file.

ops.description: Per-op outcomes in input order. Inspect `applied` / `result` / `reason` / `details` to surface rejections to the user.

reason.description: Stable failure tag for rejected ops (e.g. `no_match`, `ambiguous`, `invalid_query`, `syntax_error`, `unsupported_language`, `unknown_op`, `use_standalone`).
